messages:
maria: Heads-up: launching 'QuickStart Snippets' community sprint next Tue. We want a short tutorial series (5 micro-tuts), an OSS sample repo, a launch post, and a 45-min demo webinar. Targets: 500 signups, 200 forks. Who can own copy, benchmarks, and webinar host?
kevin: I can do the benchmark narrative. thinking 3 microbenchmarks: cold-start latency, per-token cost with batching, mem footprint vs quantization. I'll sketch numbers.
ashley: I'll own copy + landing page. Can pair with design for hero assets.
sam: @maria assign webinar host? I can host but need slide deck + 2 demos. prefer live Q&A at end.
jo: I'll prep sample repo + 5 micro-tuts. Will add Docker + local run guide. GH repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/quickstart-snippets
kevin: Benchmark kpis: target <100ms median for 512 tokens on Dedicated small; cost reduction narrative using batching (x2) and cache (x1.7). I'll create a short benchmark notebook:
```bash
# run microbenchmark
python bench.py --model redwood-small --sequence 512 --batch 8 --quant int8
```
maria: Nice. Lead routing: we should pipe signups to HubSpot list 'oss-quickstart-snippets' and create workflow to tag 'webinar-registrant' and notify AE when company size >100. @liz can you wire that?
liz: Yep. I'll map segment in HubSpot. Can we use hidden form field 'org_size' and zapier webhook to create alert in #sales-inbound? doc: https://docs.google.com/xxx
ashley: Copy draft: short headline, 3 bullets (what you'll build, time to run locally, cost & perf wins). I'll drop draft in /docs/marketing/quickstart-copy.md
sam: Webinar outline: 1) 10min overview + product story 2) 20min live build (repo quickstart) 3) 10min benchmark walkthrough 4) Q&A. Need runbook and backup host. @nina can you be backup?
nina: On it. Also volunteer to moderate chat + collect questions.
maria: Timeline: Mon - landing + repo ready; Tue - bench complete + copy final; Wed - rehearsal; Thu - webinar; Fri - launch post + social. Everyone OK?
kevin: Question: social/benchmark snippet embargo? do we want embargo until after webinar? I vote share benchmark numbers in launch post same day.
maria: :thumbsup: same-day is fine. we'll embargo detailed notebook until post goes live.
jo: I'll add quickstart Dockerfile and tiny-scale demo so attendees can follow along.
liz: HubSpot mapping done; webhook endpoint: https://hooks.redwood.com/hubspot/oss-snippets
deploy-bot: scheduled: announcement post will be queued Thu 13:00 UTC after manual approval
maria: Action items summarized: Ashley copy, Kevin benchmarks + notebook, Jo repo + demos, Sam host + slides, Liz HubSpot mapping, Nina moderator. I'll create GH issue board and assign. Thanks team :party_parrot:
